The '''Foothill Paths''' was an area of grassland and foothills on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was considered part of the [[Apalis Coast]] and troops loyal to the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]], whose [[House Organa (estate)|estate]] was built nearby, were stationed in the area throughout the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Organa soldiers fought with troops from the [[House of Thul]] in this region during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].

==Description==
The Foothill Paths was the name of an area of the [[Apalis Coast]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The area consisted of wooded grassland and rocky foothills which could be coated with snow in some seasons. A path, which included a fountain and benches, was built across the area connecting the bordering [[Pallista Spaceport]] and the [[House Organa (estate)|estate]] of [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]]. As well as the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and the estate, the area also bordered with the [[Organa power generators]] and the [[Deforested Slopes]]. The area also included a small Republic medical outpost and a [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] pad on the outskirts of the Organa estate.<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
House Organa, one of the Alderaanian [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses who supported the Republic, controlled the Foothill Paths during the Cold War, and soldiers and [[Sentry droid/Legends|guard droids]] loyal to the House patrolled the area, in which they also set up gun emplacements and flew the House's banner. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], forces of [[House of Thul]], a rival noble house who had sided with the Empire, invaded the area, battling House Organa's troops and damaging the foot path.<ref name="TOR" /> [[Liagri]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]], was stationed next to the area's medical post, where he was contacted by [[Brant Organa]] concerning coastal [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] that needed repair.<ref name="CS">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Coastal Safeguards|Alderaan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Foothill Paths first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released by [[BioWare]].
